title: Woodinville's Downtown Wine Tasting Pass
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your Downtown Wine Pass must be activated within 90 days of purchase. Experience up to four (4) Woodinville wineries in the Downtown District. After the first tasting flight redemption you will have 90 days to redeem the remaining 3 tasting flights that are included in the pass. *Redeem one flight per winery per pass.

You will receive a text message and email immediately upon purchase. The Downtown Wine Pass can be used directly from your smartphone.

Must be 21+ years old to consume alcoholic beverages.

Locations included:
- Ambassador Wines of Washington (Downtown)
- Ancestry Cellars
- Baer Winery Woodin Creek
- Barnard Griffin-Woodinville
- Brian Carter Cellars
- Martedi Winery
- Rocky Pond Winery
- TruthTeller Winery
